title: Chapter 415 Cooperation
content:
Chapter 415 Cooperation

Yan Chixia, who was surrounded in the field, suddenly heard such a very special word "His Majesty the Emperor Xing Yuan", she was startled.

Emperor is not a title that anyone can call it. It must have a certain identity and strength to be able to support it and be recognized by others.

Although there are also some ignorant Caotou kings who are born at the bottom or are arrogant and arrogant, and proclaim themselves emperors without that strength.

But even for these egomaniacs, they claim to be emperors, and at least they have a territory in a province, and at least a mansion.

It's just that these people won't be recognized by others even if they call themselves emperors.

And now that Zhong Yu sitting high above the county hall, although I don't know who it is, after all, Xixia has lived in Lanruo Temple in recent years and basically doesn't go out, and he just doesn't know that the Ming Dynasty has undergone earth-shaking changes , but just looking at the white-robed general who just came out, that is, Zhao Yun, and the well-trained soldiers behind him, it can be seen that the strength of the emperor's command is not weak.

After such a long time of experience, especially in this high-level Liaozhai, Zhao Yun, Donghuang Taiyi, Wei Zhuang, who were originally talented in martial arts, have broken through the original calm and reached the sixth level of cultivation.

But now, the sixth rank under Zhong Yu's command, together with the governor who surrendered in Huaixi Province before, has reached eight people.

With so many powerhouses of the sixth rank, and Zhong Yu himself who is about to break through the seventh rank, even against ordinary seventh ranks, his strength is not inferior. He has barely reached the status of being called an emperor.

"Crassman Yan Chixia, I don't know this place is His Majesty's place, so I sneaked in rashly, and I hope Your Majesty will forgive me." Yan Chixia is not really an ignorant person, although he doesn't understand why there is such an emperor in the place where the Ming Dynasty used to be. , and it seems to belong to other countries, but this does not hinder his awe of the emperor's imperial power in his heart, not to mention that the emperor's subordinates are extremely powerful.

Not to mention anything else, just say that the white-robed general Zhao Yun on the opposite side has a sixth-level strength cultivation base, and he is not inferior to him.

Coupled with the crowd of elite soldiers around, as well as Zhong Yu who sat on the high hall with strength that even he couldn't detect, this was no longer a force that Yan Chixia could resist.

So it's not a big deal for an old fritter like Yan Chixia to be subdued a little bit.

"It's nothing, hero Yan is a man of true temperament, free and easy, how can I blame him?" Of course Zhong Yu will not really pursue it, no matter whether it is Yan Chixia's own strength or Zhong Yu's heart. To subdue his thoughts, and even if the action of exterminating the tree demon grandma is useful this time, Zhong Yu will not really attack Yan Chixia.

"Your Majesty, Cao Min came here this time because of that scholar. He seems to have some misunderstandings about Cao Min, so he came here to clear it up." Yan Chixia said.

"No need to explain, I know you, what exactly are you doing in Lanruo Temple? Isn't it the tree demon?" Zhong Yu waved his hand.

"Your Majesty, I don't know what decision your Majesty has made." Yan Chixia was startled.

"Don't worry, this time I personally led the army to this small county, and the target is also this tree demon. This locust tree spirit has caused disasters for the whole place, and the people have suffered greatly from it, and even hooked up with the demon king of the underworld, the old demon Heishan, who has a big conspiracy to fight against the tree demon. Our human race is in serious danger, this time I will get rid of him and restore the world to a bright future." Zhong Yuyi said righteously.

"Old Black Mountain Demon?" Yan Chixia was startled when she heard that, and couldn't help thinking of the female ghost who said she was going to marry the old Black Mountain Demon. This Montenegro old demon is not a simple thing, but a ruthless monster who leads countless demons and ghosts to invade the underworld.

"That's right, the tree demon grandma is a subordinate of the Black Mountain Demon King. He was arranged here by the Montenegro old demon. I don't know what kind of plan he has, but it is ultimately not good for our human race. There is no harm in getting rid of him earlier." Zhong Yu said. Nodding his head, he spoke out his speculation.

"That tree demon is so bold. I knew she was not a kind person. She dared to collude with the old Montenegrin demon. She is extremely brave. He must not be kept." After hearing this, Yan Chixia felt a sense of justice in her heart.

Although Yan Chixia resigned because of the dim government of the Ming Dynasty, she is still worried about the people of the world.

Hearing the plan of the Black Mountain old demon at this moment, he couldn't relax, but he was very anxious at the moment, and he already planned to go back to kill the demon immediately.

"Hero Yan, don't worry, this time I have brought an army of 100,000, and there is even a powerful person like General Zhao Yun under his command. A mere demon tree can be destroyed with a flick of a finger." Zhong Yu said.

"So, Your Majesty, please allow the grass-roots people to join the army and do their part in such important events as killing demons and demons." Yan Chixia begged.

"That's exactly what I mean. It's great that Hero Yan can take the initiative to bring it up. With the help of a hero, mere monsters must be nothing to worry about." Zhong Yu was overjoyed, and quickly nodded in agreement.

This Yan Chixia is not an easy person. Her strength has reached the late sixth level, and she seems to have mastered some kind of secret technique. When she bursts out with all her strength, she can reach the combat power of the early seventh level. The strength can be said to be among all of Zhong Yu's subordinates. Among them, he himself does not fight, and no one is invincible.

Zhong Yuzhengchou didn't know how to recruit Yan Chixia. After all, he had served in the Ming Dynasty before, but he was hit by the darkness of the Ming Dynasty, and his heart was blown away. Dispirited, he could only live in seclusion in Lanruo Temple, a place where demons gather, and protect her by the way. Look at the passers-by.

He already had some prejudices against the so-called emperors in his heart, and if he wanted to recruit Yan Chixia, first of all he would feel extremely sad about this hurdle.

But now that Yan Chixia took the initiative to speak, it meant that Zhong Yu could win him over and give him favors during the period of cooperation.

After a long time, I don't believe that Yan Chixia's heart is really made of iron, so he will remain indifferent.

However, looking at Yan Chixia's attitude towards Ning Caichen and Nie Xiaoqian in the original book, it can be seen that he is not really a stubborn, pedantic person, and his heart is still full of love for this world.

In other words, recruiting Yan Chixia has a great possibility of success.

"It's getting late now, our army has just arrived, and it's not easy for the army to move. It's better to rest for one night. After the army is fully prepared, we will eradicate the demons and ghosts in the forest around Lanruo Temple in one fell swoop, and return Guobei County to a righteous way." Looking at the sky, it was already late at night, Zhong Yu persuaded Yan Chixia.

"That's it, thank you Your Majesty for your kindness." Yan Chixia said gratefully.

After that, the two talked a lot and got along very happily.

As for Ning Caichen, the real protagonist, he was gorgeously ignored.

It's just a frail scholar, except for his life's luck, which can attract attention, whether it's literary talent or his own strength, it's basically a scum level, and it's not worth paying attention to.
